$comment: Geometry recipes (pipeline/transit_pipeline/past.py): the heritage railways along today's track as OpenStreetMap maps and names it (Overture rail). GTFS doesn't cover them.

ncry-niles-sunol.note: OpenStreetMap's ways named Niles Canyon Railway, from its Niles station to the Sunol depot at Kilkare Rd (Overture's places), the stretch its public trains run

nvwt-napa-st-helena.note: OpenStreetMap's ways named Napa Valley Railroad, from the McKinstry St station in Napa to the St. Helena station (Overture's places)

wrm-rio-vista-jct-south.note: OpenStreetMap's ways named Western Railway Museum, from the museum at Rio Vista Junction south to where the named track ends
